inheritancePolicy.commonContent: Mechanical, diesel, fuel, oil, water, pneumatic and other content may be inherited only where applicability is explicitly confirmed for the profile.
inheritancePolicy.variantOverrides: Electrical/electronic control, layout and variant-only equipment must live in the variant layer when they differ.
inheritancePolicy.noNegativeInheritance: Absence of a variant-only feature is explicit. A profile must never inherit CHME3T rheostatic-brake equipment merely because it shares electronic equipment with CHME3T.
inheritancePolicy.unknownExecution: When actual equipment or modernization is unknown, variant-dependent actions fail closed.
